_doc: Minimum SSIM of the leading 400 pt strip (compare.mjs result.strip.ssim) per platform and screen. Plan 5.4 and section 10 (Q9): iOS 0.90 map-heavy / 0.85 text-heavy; Android 0.85 map / 0.80 text (owner decision). 'interim' lowers a floor below the target while a known gap is open; the gate uses interim when present. Ratchet up, never down, except by an explicit interim entry with a reason.
